```{r setup}
#| include: false
lib <- Sys.glob("../renv/library/*/R-4.6/*")
.libPaths(c(lib, .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(knitr) })

data_dir <- Sys.getenv("TESI_DATA")
stopifnot("TESI_DATA not set" = nzchar(data_dir), dir.exists(data_dir))
pilot_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "derived", "pilot")
tissues <- c("colon", "lymphoid", "brain")

# read <tissue>_crule_pilot_<what>.csv; NULL (with a note) if missing
rd_pilot <- function(tissue, what) {
  f <- file.path(pilot_dir, sprintf("%s_crule_pilot_%s.csv", tissue, what))
  if (!file.exists(f)) { message("missing: ", f); return(NULL) }
  read.csv(f, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
show_pilot <- function(what, n = 20) {
  for (t in tissues) {
    x <- rd_pilot(t, what)
    cat("\n\n**", t, "**\n\n", sep = "")
    if (is.null(x)) cat("*not available yet*\n") else print(kable(head(x, n)))
  }
}
```

**Single goal.** Fix the study protocol (ADEMP) before any result, and run a declared pilot whose only use is to give the values the pre-registered rules need. These are the SD of the paired differences for n_sim, runtimes, failures, seed check and depth reached (ADEMP §10). Pilot numbers do not enter the thesis results.

**Dependencies.** T1 (datasets, split). **Branch.** `thesis/expression-sources`. **Data.** `TESI_DATA` on lesexp (`/mnt/micron/geo_spatialtrans/tesi_pp1209/data`).

**Status of the pilot inputs.** Pilot references were rebuilt with φ estimated on 50,000 cells after the failed φ check (DECISIONS 2026-11-11). Only the colon pilot is rerun with the new φ; lymph node and brain pilots keep φ from 20,000 cells, as the same row states. [TO FILL: date the colon rerun finished.]

# 1. Pre-registration

Written before the pilot runs. Full text in `protocol/ADEMP.md` (v1.4, 2026-11-11); approval by Luca [TO FILL: date].

| Item | Rule fixed before the pilot | Source |
|---|---|---|
| Pilot scope | three tissues, arms E and C− plus the real anchor, CPU methods, 10 replicates per arm × condition; pilot held-out and E′ donors drawn from training | ADEMP §10; DECISIONS 2026-10-30 |
| n_sim | 2 × MCSE of the paired RMSE difference ≤ δ/2, SD = upper limit from the pilot, δ = 0.02 | DECISIONS 2026-11-03 (two rows) |
| Dirichlet concentration | α_k = c · p_k, c = median over R6 ROIs per tissue and cells level | DECISIONS 2026-11-06 |
| Depth thinning | exact downsampling to the target, report spots below target | DECISIONS 2026-11-02 |
| Failures | null-baseline fill, common-spot set as sensitivity, tolerance 1e-5 | DECISIONS 2026-11-03, 2026-11-03 (ADEMP v0.9) |
| φ sample | r(log φ) ≥ 0.99 and median ratio 0.95–1.05, else 50,000 cells | DECISIONS 2026-10-29 |
| Reference cap | 1,000 cells per type kept if r ≥ 0.99 per type | DECISIONS 2026-11-04 |
| P marker cap | Jaccard ≥ 0.9 per type in the lymph node, else 20,000 | DECISIONS 2026-11-11 |

## Deviations from the pre-registration (recorded, not corrected)

- The φ sample check was run on 2026-11-11, after the pilots, although it was due before them (DECISIONS 2026-11-11).
- The pilots ran at 175 and 4,900 UMI per cell in every tissue. After the pilots the design kept one Visium HD level per tissue, 174 (colon), 62 (lymph node) and 121 (brain) UMI per cell (DECISIONS 2026-11-12, PROTOCOLLO 1.5). n_sim uses only the 175 rows; for the lymph node and brain the pilot depth was higher than the final level.
- Lymph node and brain pilots used φ from 20,000 cells and were not rerun (DECISIONS 2026-11-11 on φ).

# 5. Values passed to the protocol

## 5.1 n_sim

```{r nsim}
#| results: asis
show_pilot("nsim")
```

The `nsim` tables above take the maximum over all pilot conditions, 4,900 UMI included. The design value uses the 175 UMI rows of `rmse_pairs` only (DECISIONS 2026-11-12).

```{r nsim-hd}
nsim_hd <- do.call(rbind, lapply(tissues, function(t) {
  x <- rd_pilot(t, "rmse_pairs")
  if (is.null(x)) return(NULL)
  x <- x[x$depth == 175, ]
  r <- x[which.max(x$sd_diff_upper), ]
  data.frame(tissue = t, sd_upper = r$sd_diff_upper, arm = r$dataset, n_cells = r$n_cells,
             pair = r$pair, n_sim = ceiling((4 * r$sd_diff_upper / 0.02)^2))
}))
kable(nsim_hd, digits = 4)
```

Expected from DECISIONS 2026-11-12: colon 0.0543 (n_sim 118), lymph node 0.019 (14), brain 0.029 (33), so n_sim = 118.
